title: Fyan: A Human--AI Harness with Semantic Auditing for Document-Level Formalization
abstract: arXiv:2609.39228v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present FYAN, a human--AI harness for document-level mathematical formalization. Rather than treating theorems in isolation, FYAN coordinates an end-to-end workflow spanning specification, proof planning, logical review, Lean proof construction, knowledge curation, and validation, with support for independent supervision and human guidance. A central component is evidence-grounded semantic auditing, which assesses whether formal statements faithfully preserve their informal specifications. A language model constructs structured evidence over local correspondences, omissions, scope, and logical relations, while a deterministic validator checks this evidence and produces reproducible judgments. When a substantive but admissible deviation is accepted, FYAN requires an explicit proof-transfer obligation connecting the formal statement back to a source-facing interpretation. translated_title: FYAN：一个具有语义审计功能的人机协同文档级形式化系统
translated_abstract: 我们提出了FYAN，一个用于文档级数学形式化的人机协同框架。FYAN不是孤立地处理定理，而是协调一个端到端的工作流程，涵盖规约说明、证明规划、逻辑审查、Lean证明构建、知识管理以及验证，并支持独立监督和人工指导。其核心组件是基于证据的语义审计，用于评估形式化陈述是否忠实地保留了其非形式化的规约说明。语言模型围绕局部对应关系、省略内容、范围和逻辑关系构建结构化证据，同时一个确定性验证器检查这些证据并产生可复现的判断。当一个实质性但可被接受的偏差得到确认时，FYAN要求一个显式的证明转移义务，将形式化陈述与面向原始文本的解读联系起来。在所有阶段使用相同的模型（DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash），FYAN……
tldr: FYAN是一个人机协同的文档级数学形式化框架，其核心创新在于基于证据的语义审计机制——由语言模型构建结构化证据、由确定性验证器产生可复现判断，从而确保形式化陈述忠实地保留非形式化规约，并协调从规约说明到Lean证明构建的端到端工作流程。
en_tdlr: FYAN is a human-AI harness for document-level mathematical formalization whose key innovation is evidence-grounded semantic auditing, where a language model builds structured evidence and a deterministic validator produces reproducible judgments to ensure formal statements faithfully preserve informal specifications within an end-to-end formalization workflow.
